title: If the earthquake did not time it we should know where to place poor Wat, sitting in his form, the cry of hounds, the studded bridle and her blue windows. That memory, Venus and Adonis, lay in the bedchamber of every light-of-love in London.
html_source:
These sentences contain five references to Venus and Adonis, Shakespeare.

It is a narrative poem written in approximately 1593 (Wikipedia). It borrows from Ovid’s Metamorphoses Book 10 and significantly for Stephen’s oration has considerable characteristics of Aristotle’s -theory of tragedy.

That theory is firmly rooted in us – people. It is showing not telling. An unnarrated series of incidents the audience experiences. It is far from AE’s views of universal truths (a philosophy of Plato) which can only be accessed by humans through art and the artist.

It’s also a comment on Shakespeare by Joyce. Shakespeare wrote Venus and Adonis deliberately for the court market and he was rewarded with a fifteen edition run up to the 1640’s.
